dog.initial: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent animation sprite strip for Lemmi robot. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, Kylie's original dog avatar. Create ONE horizontal sprite strip with THREE equally sized square cells, no gutters, no text, no cell borders, transparent background. Cell order left to right: (1) neutral friendly open eyes, CLOSED mouth (small curved smile); (2) same open eyes, OPEN mouth exactly as reference; (3) same avatar with gently closed happy eyes, closed smiling mouth and THREE small peach-pink hearts above its head as petting acknowledgment. Remove any ellipsis dots. Preserve original character identity, outline, ears, body, paws, tail, palette, watercolor paper texture and hand-drawn brown stroke. The three body silhouettes must be pixel-aligned at the exact same size, position and baseline within their cells, with space reserved above the head for hearts in ALL cells. Only mouth changes between first two cells; no eye/body/scale movement. Show entire character, no cropping. Hearts do not overlap head. No words, labels, shadow, new accessories or background. This is a production sprite strip, not a presentation or scene. Aspect ratio 3:1.
